description: Fragment: merge these packageRules into renovate.json, after the rules the shared preset adds. Rules apply in order; a later match wins.

packageRules.description: NuGet packages, the .NET SDK in global.json and the local tools are build tooling: build(deps), which releases nothing.
Packages that ship as dependencies of this repository's NuGet packages (the <dependency> elements of the packed .nuspec files): fix(deps), so an update releases a patch.
A new major of the .NET SDK goes with a framework upgrade: never merged unattended.
Microsoft.Testing.Platform and its extensions must stay on one release line (MTP 2.4+ constrains extensions to the platform's major).
